_README: Per-nationality visa deep-dive: Indonesia → Korea. Grounded in official channels (Embassy of Korea in Indonesia, Korea Visa Portal) + 2026 immigration briefings. Fee/processing VOLATILE (factId visa-indonesia-c3). No invented figures.

verdict.headline: Individual Indonesian tourists need a visa — but groups may not.
verdict.sub: For solo/independent travel to mainland Korea you apply for the C-3 tourist visa. Since 28 May 2026, tour groups of 3+ can enter visa-free for short stays under a trial scheme — individuals are not yet eligible.
verdict.entry: Single entry (individuals) / visa-free for qualifying groups

highlights.title: Group visa-free from 28 May 2026
highlights.body: Indonesian tour groups of at least 3 people can enter visa-free for short stays under a trial scheme. It's group-only — individual travelers still need a visa.

highlights.title: Jeju Island — separate visa-free entry
highlights.body: Indonesian citizens can enter Jeju visa-free (Jeju only, direct flights, no mainland transit). This is separate from the mainland tourist visa.

tldr: Independent travelers need a C-3 tourist visa for mainland Korea.
Fill the form at visa.go.kr, then submit at the Korean Embassy / KVAC Jakarta.
Bring passport, photo, 3-month bank statement, employment letter + salary slips.
Travelling in a group of 3+? You may qualify for visa-free entry (trial from May 2026).

steps.title: The application, step by step (individual C-3)

items.title: Confirm the visa type
items.detail: Independent tourists apply for the C-3 short-term tourist visa. (Groups of 3+ should ask their agency about the visa-free trial.)

items.title: Fill the form at visa.go.kr
items.detail: Complete the application form on the Korea Visa Portal — the only official site — then print and sign it.

items.title: Prepare your documents
items.detail: Gather the checklist below: passport, photo, 3-month bank statement, and job proof.

items.title: Submit at the Embassy / KVAC Jakarta
items.detail: Lodge your application with the Korean Embassy or the Korea Visa Application Center in Jakarta.

items.title: Pay the fee
items.detail: Pay the visa fee and any service fee. Fees are non-refundable even if refused — confirm the amount at the center.

items.title: Track & wait
items.detail: Follow the status via the center's channel. Don't buy non-refundable flights before approval.

items.title: Collect your passport
items.detail: Pick up your passport and check the visa details immediately.

documents.title: Document checklist — with where & how to get each
documents.intro: For each item, here is where to obtain it and what it must show.

rows.how: Complete on the Korea Visa Portal, print, sign.
Statement showing balance and transaction history; a stable balance is best.
On company letterhead: position, salary, and approved leave.
Reservations/itinerary are enough — don't pay for a ticket before approval.

funds.title: "How much money should I show?"
funds.body: There is no single published minimum. Show a stable 3-month balance and clear ties to Indonesia (job, family). If someone else funds your trip, document the sponsorship fully.
tips: A steady 3-month balance beats a sudden deposit before applying.
Pair the bank statement with your employment letter and salary slips.
Sponsored? Add the sponsor's bank statement, letter, and relationship proof.

items.d: The visa-free trial is group-only (3+). Individual travelers still need a C-3 visa.
A big lump sum right before applying. Show steady, explainable funds.
Missing employment letter or payslips. These anchor an individual applicant's file.
Buying non-refundable tickets before approval — a reservation is enough.
Jeju visa-free doesn't cover mainland Korea travel.

items.q: Do Indonesians need a visa for Korea?
items.a: Individual travelers need a C-3 tourist visa for mainland Korea. Since 28 May 2026, tour groups of 3+ can enter visa-free under a trial; Jeju Island has separate visa-free entry.

items.q: I'm travelling alone — can I skip the visa?
items.a: No. The visa-free trial applies only to groups of at least 3 people. Independent travelers must apply for the C-3 visa.

items.q: What financial proof do I need?
items.a: A 3-month bank statement plus an employment letter and salary slips. If sponsored, include the sponsor's documents.
At the Korean Embassy or the Korea Visa Application Center in Jakarta.
Fees vary and are non-refundable even if refused. Confirm the current amount at the center.

items.q: Do I still need the e-Arrival Card?
items.a: Entry-document rules such as the e-Arrival Card can still apply on arrival. Check the current rules near your travel date.
